headline: Amazon Launches Alexa Text-Based Shopping Feature in the U.S.
summary: Amazon introduced a new feature allowing customers in the U.S. to search for products, compare prices, and make purchases via text message using its AI-powered shopping assistant, Alexa for Shopping.
why: Amazon is a global e-commerce and cloud computing giant expanding its AI-driven retail tools to engage consumers.

impacts.name: Amazon.com Inc.
impacts.why: Launch of a new AI-powered text shopping feature for U.S. consumers.
